mods.name: DXVK
mods.summary: Runs the game's graphics through Vulkan, which is usually smoother on modern graphics cards
mods.details: Needs a graphics card with Vulkan support. If the game won't start or shows a black screen, switch it off.
mods.author: Raz0r1337 (fork of DXVK)

presets.name: Mod Defaults
presets.description: No settings file: DXVK uses its own defaults, including a double-size mouse cursor.

presets.name: Original Cursor Size
presets.description: Turns the cursor enlargement off, for screens where the doubled cursor is too big (often 4K).

presets.name: LuxVelum MSAA Fix
presets.description: Reports an AMD graphics card, so LuxVelum keeps antialiasing on NVIDIA and Intel cards; double-size cursor. If odd graphics glitches appear, go back to Mod Defaults.

presets.name: LuxVelum MSAA Fix, Original Cursor
presets.description: The LuxVelum MSAA Fix with the cursor enlargement off.

mods.name: Lexara
mods.details: If text looks wrong, switch it off.
mods.author: Stormhand

mods.name: LuxVelum
mods.details: Press Ctrl+F7 in game for its settings (Insert with the Project Reforged preset). If fog flickers, set Multisampling to 1x in the game's Video options.
mods.author: Raz0r1337 (fork of Coa-vFog)

presets.name: Project Reforged
presets.description: Project Reforged's recommended settings, downloaded from their site: lighter fog, sun rays and color grading, brighter lamps in the fog, calmer water, and a faster fog quality. Its settings window opens with Insert instead of Ctrl+F7. Its per-region fog for Outland and Northrend needs a newer LuxVelum and is skipped by this one. If fog flickers, set Multisampling to 1x in the game's Video options.

mods.name: wow-optimize
mods.details: Built by the launcher from its public source at v3.23.1. The official releases add closed code that hides its hooks from server checks; this build leaves it out. It checks GitHub for its own updates and, by default, logs the game's network timing. If the game crashes or acts strange, switch it off.
mods.author: suprepupre

presets.name: Mod Defaults
presets.description: No settings file: wow-optimize uses its author's tested defaults, including a log file per session (the last 10 are kept in Logs) and network timing diagnostics.

presets.name: Fewer Diagnostics
presets.description: The author's defaults without the parts that only observe: no session logs, no network timing hook, no code audit, flight recorder or load counters. If something goes wrong, switch back to Mod Defaults so there's a log to look at.

mods.name: Login and Character Select
mods.summary: A cleaner login screen and a nicer character list you can reorder by dragging
mods.details: The optional Remember Password box saves your password as plain text in WTF\Config.wtf.
mods.author: Expulsion

mods.name: Short Self Combat Text
mods.summary: Big numbers in the combat text around your own character shortened (12.3K, 1.2M)
mods.details: Matches the Short Combat Numbers patch, which does the same for numbers over targets.
mods.author: Expulsion

mods.name: Project Reforged Fix
mods.summary: Makes Project Reforged's character creation screen work on Synastria
mods.details: Only for clients with Project Reforged installed. Uninstall it if you remove Reforged, or the login screen breaks.
mods.author: Expulsion
